title: Layla in the snow text and questions
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Friends of nature; Layla in the snow; Salem at the zoo
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 9 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Layla in the snow text and questions)
intro: Lesson 9: Reading: Layla in the snow (لَيْلَى فِي الثَّلْجِ). Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
خَرَجَتْ لَيْلَى إِلَى الحَدِيقَةِ.
الثَّلْجُ أَبْيَضُ، وَالجَوُّ بَارِدٌ.
لَبِسَتْ لَيْلَى مِعْطَفًا وَقُفَّازَيْنِ.
لَعِبَتْ لَيْلَى فِي الثَّلْجِ مَعَ أَخِيهَا.
ثُمَّ رَجَعَتْ إِلَى البَيْتِ وَشَرِبَتْ حَلِيبًا سَاخِنًا.

panels.title: Meaning
points: Layla went out to the garden
The snow is white; the weather is cold
She wore a coat and gloves; then drank hot milk

questions.q: Where did Layla go? Answer in Arabic.
Reading questions on the pupil PDF: five questions (two in Arabic, three in English), then underline every verb that ends in ـَتْ (she did).
questions.a: Garden; white; coat and gloves; with her brother; hot milk. Verbs: خَرَجَتْ، لَبِسَتْ، لَعِبَتْ، رَجَعَتْ، شَرِبَتْ

questions.q: Extend: what does ـَتْ at the end of a verb tell us?
questions.a: A girl (she) did it, in the past.

questions.q: Stretch: retell in two Arabic sentences.
questions.a: For example: خَرَجَتْ لَيْلَى. لَعِبَتْ فِي الثَّلْجِ.
A) A coat and gloves. لَبِسَتْ لَيْلَى مِعْطَفًا وَقُفَّازَيْنِ.

questions.q: Think again: what would you do first in snow?
questions.a: Pupils' own; for example: أَلْبَسُ مِعْطَفًا (I put on a coat)
